requirements.requirement: A managed service named inventory-worker runs /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker on node1.
requirements.summary: The installed systemd unit is named inventory-worker.service, specifies the requested executable, validates successfully, is enabled, and is directly observed active and running both before and after reboot.

requirements.requirement: The service runs under the dedicated inventorysvc account.
requirements.summary: inventorysvc was newly created as a system account with its own UID/GID and nologin shell. The unit declares that user and group, and the live worker process UID directly matches the account UID before and after reboot.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied. The mandatory node-restart protocol is also complete: it captures a healthy pre-restart service and boot identity, restart scheduling and bounded loss of connectivity, a different post-restart identity, a running system, and recovery of the enabled service under inventorysvc. The fixed lifecycle boot observations independently corroborate the boot-ID transition.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. The bounded manual worker run was a transient prerequisite check and was terminated; account creation, unit installation, daemon reload, and enable/start directly implemented the task; the scheduled reboot served the mandatory restart protocol. Post-executor observations show no failed services, no new network exposure, and healthy package state. Temporary-directory changes are expected reboot/systemd private directories, including the task-required service directory, rather than abandoned residue.
